concerns.text: Plan 'Adaptive Model Selection' Case A (Missing Data → Synthetic) and Case C (Small N → Ridge) are unimplemented. T037 explicitly forbids synthetic fallback and T000e enforces a 'Fail Loud' policy that crashes the pipeline if real data is missing. This creates a logical deadlock where the pipeline cannot run on a fresh runner without pre-seeded data, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and leaving FR-001/FR-004 unfulfilled.

Plan requires synthetic runs to be explicitly labeled ('Label source: synthetic', 'Flag: low_power') to distinguish from real data. T037b explicitly forbids writing 'IS_SYNTHETIC_RUN: true' to results/research.md, and no task exists to set the required 'source' label in the output artifacts. This prevents the system from executing a valid end-to-end test with synthetic data, violating Plan 'Sampling Strategy' and SC-002.

Plan 'Global vs Local Split' requires testing the global hypothesis (batch covariance/eigenvalue) alongside local features. T022a/T022c compute global metrics but T022a explicitly forbids appending the global eigenvalue to per-sample features, and T027a (training) only uses per-sample features. No task exists to incorporate the global eigenvalue as a predictor or to perform the required bootstrapping on the batch-level covariance, leaving the 'Global Analysis' requirement unimplemented.

Plan 'Feature Set Definition' lists 5 entanglement features (Variance, Entropy, Skewness, Kurtosis, Difficulty Proxy). T030d requires partial correlation but ambiguously specifies using 'variance' as the primary feature without defining which of the 5 features to use or how to handle the others. This creates an implementation gap where the statistical test may not align with the Plan's intended 'Complexity Tracking' to isolate the entanglement effect.

T014 requires generating a lineage report with a SHA-256 hash of the *source code* of the `derive_primary_dimension_from_metadata` function. No task exists to actually compute this hash or write it to the artifact. This creates an untestable requirement where the output artifact cannot be generated as specified, violating SC-004 (Target Independence verification).

T000b references T000c-external (Reference-Validator Agent) which is not defined as a task in the plan or spec. The task assumes an external agent exists that is not part of the implementation scope, creating a dependency on a non-existent component.
